approval.basis: User explicitly requested breakdown and GitHub upload of remaining female day running editorials.

copy.captionEn: Sand and navy. An easy start.
copy.captionDe: Sand und Marineblau. Ein entspannter Start.
copy.introKo: 샌드 셸 아래 짙은 네이비를 길게 이어줘요. 여유 있는 러닝 팬츠의 밑단을 정돈하고, 그레이 삭스와 밝은 메쉬 러너로 발끝을 가볍게 마무리해요.
copy.introEn: Run dark navy beneath a sand shell. Keep the tapered trousers neat at the ankle, then finish with grey socks and pale mesh runners.
copy.introDe: Kombiniere eine sandfarbene Jacke mit dunklem Marineblau. Halte die schmal zulaufende Hose am Knöchel ordentlich und ergänze graue Socken sowie helle Mesh-Laufschuhe.

products.descriptionKo: 밝은 샌드 셸을 네이비 위에 열어 입어요. 어두운 이너가 앞면을 세로로 정리해요.
products.descriptionEn: Wear the sand shell open over navy, letting the dark inner layer create a clean vertical line.
products.descriptionDe: Trage die sandfarbene Jacke offen über Marineblau; die dunkle Lage bildet eine klare vertikale Linie.
products.altKo: 샌드 러닝 셸 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: sand-beige lightweight hooded full-zip running windbreaker, elastic cuffs, subtle silver reflective strips on shoulders and forearms, match reference drape

products.descriptionKo: 네이비 크루넥을 팬츠와 이어 한 톤처럼 보여줘요. 소매 끝만 셸 밖으로 짧게 드러내요.
products.descriptionEn: Link the navy crew neck to the trousers and let just a little cuff show beyond the shell.
products.descriptionDe: Verbinde das marineblaue Rundhalsshirt farblich mit der Hose und lasse nur etwas Bündchen unter der Jacke hervorschauen.
products.altKo: 네이비 러닝 롱슬리브 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: dark navy crewneck long-sleeve base-layer shirt; neckline/chest and cuffs visible, hidden torso conservatively reconstructed

products.descriptionKo: 타이츠 대신 여유 있는 테이퍼드 핏으로 가요. 밑단을 발목 위에 정리해 신발의 형태를 드러내요.
products.descriptionEn: Choose a relaxed taper instead of tights and keep the hems neat above the shoes.
products.descriptionDe: Wähle statt Tights eine lockere, schmal zulaufende Hose und ordne den Saum oberhalb der Schuhe.
products.altKo: 잉크 러닝 팬츠 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: dark ink navy slim tapered woven running trousers, elastic ankle cuffs and narrow silver reflective lower-leg accents, not skin-tight leggings

products.descriptionKo: 블랙 글러브는 네이비와 자연스럽게 연결해요. 벗었을 때는 셸 포켓에 정리해요.
products.descriptionEn: Black gloves blend into the navy palette; tuck them into a shell pocket when removed.
products.descriptionDe: Schwarze Handschuhe fügen sich in die dunkle Palette ein; verstaue sie nach dem Ausziehen in einer Jackentasche.
products.altKo: 블랙 러닝 글러브 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: matching pair of black full-finger running gloves, based on the glove tucked beside the hip; hidden fingers and palms conservatively reconstructed, no invented logos

products.descriptionKo: 그레이 삭스를 팬츠와 밝은 러너 사이에 조금 보여줘요. 발목에 원단이 뭉치지 않게 정리해요.
products.descriptionEn: Let grey socks bridge the dark trousers and pale runners without bunching at the ankle.
products.descriptionDe: Graue Socken verbinden die dunkle Hose mit den hellen Laufschuhen, ohne sich am Knöchel zu stauen.
products.altKo: 그레이 앵클 삭스 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: matching pair of medium grey heather ankle running socks, match visible sock cuffs; hidden foot sections conservatively reconstructed

products.descriptionKo: 오프화이트 메쉬 러너로 전체 톤을 가볍게 끝내요. 끈은 갑피 위에 가지런히 정리해요.
products.descriptionEn: Finish the muted palette with off-white mesh runners and keep the laces tidy.
products.descriptionDe: Runde die gedeckte Palette mit Offwhite-Mesh-Laufschuhen ab und binde die Schnürsenkel ordentlich.
products.altKo: 오프화이트 메쉬 러너 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: matching pair of off-white light grey mesh running sneakers, off-white laces, chunky cream sculpted soles, small grey toe/outsole accents

reconstructionNotes: Hidden backs, waistbands, inside construction and opposite shoes are conservative reconstructions, not verified product specifications.
Exact temperature and feels-like temperature are unknown; Chilly is grounded in the source folder.
Gloves reconstructed from the partially visible black glove tucked at the hip; base-layer sleeves are partly inferred.
